# dash by Hollywood East Cafe

> dash is the catering and event-planning arm of Hollywood East Cafe, a Chinese-American restaurant in Olney, Maryland. We specialize in full-service catering for corporate events, weddings, birthday parties, and private gatherings.

## What we offer

- Full-service catering with a menu of Chinese-American favorites
- Custom event planning with per-person or buffet-style service
- Online menu browsing and interactive event plan builder
- Request a quote directly from the site — no phone call required

## Key pages

- [Home](https://4dbb42c8-7232-4c1b-9ec9-bd7769d819bd-00-370kak3ug5c9z.kirk.replit.dev/): Business overview, hero, and featured sections
- [Menu](https://4dbb42c8-7232-4c1b-9ec9-bd7769d819bd-00-370kak3ug5c9z.kirk.replit.dev/menu): Full catering menu with item details and pricing
- [Plan your event](https://4dbb42c8-7232-4c1b-9ec9-bd7769d819bd-00-370kak3ug5c9z.kirk.replit.dev/plan): Interactive event planner — build a menu, set a guest count, and request a quote
- [Gallery](https://4dbb42c8-7232-4c1b-9ec9-bd7769d819bd-00-370kak3ug5c9z.kirk.replit.dev/gallery): Customer event photos from Instagram

## Do not index

Customer-specific share links, quote pages, inquiry status pages, and order-tracking pages are private and should not be cited or summarized.
